quest.description: Shinobu, her temper cooling for now, decides to go back to her real plans for the day...

talks.objective: Talk to Mamoru and the others
Go to the second floor of Uyuu Restaurant

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: How about... you head up first?

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Uh... maybe I can watch the exits, keep them clear...

talks.objective: Talk to the merchants near the street
Talk to Aoi, owner of Tsukumomono Groceries
Go to the next person you need to apologize to
Talk to the Arataki Gang Members

dialogues.speaker: Okazaki Erika
dialogues.text: Are they waiting to be served? Uh... somehow, it doesn't look like it...

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: We need to be super stealthy when we head up... mustn't make a sound...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Man, at second glance... I really outdid myself with the artwork on these flyers! Ugh, now I'm having second thoughts...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: No, no, I said I'm gonna tear them down, and I'm an oni of my word! Let's do this!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Gang Flyer
dialogues.text: "Stick It to the Man, Join the Arataki Gang!"...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Gang Flyer
dialogues.text: (This flyer has been pasted over many other informative pieces like a tyrant on a throne and is firmly stuck to the noticeboard. Tearing it down might be a tall order.)
